vacancies.title: Technical Support Engineer
vacancies.intro: We are looking to hire an experienced, professional, motivated and efficient Technical Support Engineer to join our support team.
vacancies.summary: A hands-on support role for an experienced IT professional who can work across Microsoft server platforms, networking, virtualisation, cloud services, and day-to-day client support.
responsibilities: Provide responsive technical support to business clients.
Install, configure, upgrade, and maintain Microsoft server platforms.
Support routers, firewalls, switches, wireless infrastructure, IP telephony, and related systems.
Document systems, network issues, and fixes for future reference.
requirements: Hold a degree in computer science or equivalent.
Have a minimum of 2 years' experience in a similar post.
Provide technical support on Microsoft server platforms including installation, configuration, upgrades and maintenance.
Be experienced with routers, firewalls, switches, server technologies, wireless infrastructure, IP telephony, installation and configuration.
VMware and Hyper-V installation, configuration and monitoring.
Office 365 and SharePoint configuration and monitoring.
Be familiar with network design and infrastructure and document systems or network problems for future reference.
Work effectively under pressure, multitask and meet deadlines.
Be highly motivated, meticulous and possess excellent organisational and communication skills.
assets: Industry certification from Microsoft, HP, Cisco, Mikrotik, or other IT industry leaders.
Certifications including MCP, MCSA, MCSE, ITIL, CCNA and 3CX.
A clean driving licence and own transport.

apply.instructions: CV upload requires the live WordPress application form. The original application link is preserved below.

vacancies.title: Junior IT Support Officer
vacancies.intro: We are looking for a young and cheerful Junior IT Support Officer to join our support team.
vacancies.summary: An entry-level support role for someone eager to learn, support business users, and grow practical technical skills with the PC Gen team.
responsibilities: Assist clients with day-to-day technical support requests.
Help with workstation setup, software support, and basic troubleshooting.
Escalate technical issues clearly to senior team members.
Keep support notes and client updates accurate.
requirements: Have a strong interest in IT support and business technology.
Be willing to learn across Microsoft, networking, and cloud environments.
Communicate clearly with clients and colleagues.
Work effectively under pressure, multitask and meet deadlines.
Be highly motivated, meticulous and organised.
assets: Previous helpdesk, desktop support, or customer service experience.
A clean driving licence and own transport.
